verdict.rationale: The evidence shows fleet-wide visibility, analytics by device group or tag, and configuration templates. None of this documents applying an action, such as a command, configuration change, or update, to many devices in one bulk operation. Commands are described per device, via a button in the Observe view or during teleoperation, and multi-device views and aggregated analytics are adjacent read and visualization features, not bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
